Both teams cruised past Chinese Taipei with relative ease and now come up against each other in a crunch encounter. Kyrgyzstan are on a good run of form, but Vietnam have been in the form of their life in 2026.

We expect a tough encounter here between the sides, with the Golden Star Warriors coming up trumps eventually.

Prediction: Kyrgyzstan 1-2 Vietnam
